description: smart_refine_2 improved CCC by +0.09 but introduced 2 new severe clashes and pushed ligand strain from 3 to 11 kcal/mol.

expected_decision.rationale: Density bias is pulling the ligand into geometrically unfavourable territory. Rerun with softer density restraints to balance map fit and chemistry.

notes: Acceptable alternate: rerun_smart_refine_alt_score switching to a less density-greedy score.
